description: CASSI in Cary's Bond Park Usage (Days of Week with Highest Ridership) is a dataset listed in Cary, NC Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Cary. Beep, Inc. provided weekly data reports to Cary and the North Carolina Department of Transportation (NCDOT) that included ridership and operations data. This dataset is a subset of the CASSI in Cary's Bond Park Usage dataset featuring the Passengers per Hour Operated for each weekday. Coverage: Cary, North Carolina. The portal files it under Transport, Movements. Its keywords are CASSI, beep. The portal shows 5 records. The portal shows 2026-03-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-townofcary-org-portal.
